title: Nashville Pole Dance and Meditation Experience - All Levels
includes: Small group setting for personalized attention
Mats, pillows, and pole equipment provided
Guided meditation session to follow the workout
Pole fitness instruction in a safe, supportive environment
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Most pole fitness classes take place in dance studios filled with bright lights and mirrors. Our space is designed for comfort, relaxation and play. The floor is cushioned and the lights are low. It helps pull us out of presentation (where we spend so much of our time these days) and into the moment. The low lights help us to soften and connect to our bodies and the amazing community in class. 

You'll be amazed by what an incredible workout you get while relaxing and having fun.
